headline:
Design Driven
by Purpose
bio: Hands-on experience in 3D printing and general crafting with *5 years* in the cardboard craft and structural/sculptural events industry.
Practiced at typography, publication design and advertising with my *Communication Design Diploma* at Temasek Polytechnic.
My *Computer Science Degree* at SUSS complements my making background with a technical foundation useful for electronics, IT workshops, or CAD/design instruction.
